title: Voting round
description: A voting round as seen by one recipient in sessionState (FR-018 to FR-022). While the round is OPEN, `myVotes` holds only the recipient's own votes, `progress` shows how many features each participant has scored, and `results` is null: nobody sees the others' values before the reveal (FR-019, SC-004). Once REVEALED, `myVotes` is empty and `results` carries every vote, the minimum and maximum per criterion, the large spreads and the unanimous values (FR-020, FR-021). Votes and results are keyed by criterion key of the session's method.

number.description: Sequential number in the session, from 1.

previousRoundId.description: Set when the round was relaunched from a previous one (FR-022).

progress.description: For every participant, the number of features of the round with at least one value entered (FR-019).

myVotes.description: The recipient's own votes by feature id (an empty object when the recipient has not voted yet, and once the round is revealed).

results.description: Null while the round is OPEN.

votes.description: One entry per participant who gave at least one value. A missing key or null is displayed "sans avis".

nonVoters.description: Participants registered at reveal time who gave no value at all ("n'a pas voté").

min.description: Minimum per criterion over the values entered; null when nobody entered one (FR-020).

largeSpread.description: Criteria whose maximum minus minimum is strictly greater than 3 (FR-020).

unanimous.description: Value of a criterion when everyone who gave one gave the same; null otherwise (prefills the consensus, FR-021).
